verdict.reason: Dropping R would lower the maximum VIF from 9.43 to 2.47, cost only 0.0085 of in-sample R2, and raise grouped k-fold from 0.4164 to 0.4226. It is retained anyway: acting on that improvement after seeing it is post-hoc specification selection, which is the practice this paper argues against. The dependence is disclosed instead of engineered away.
